cover.title: The most crowded place on Earth. Now empty.

lines.text: This island was once the most crowded place on Earth. Now, nobody lives here at all.
Hashima, off the coast of Nagasaki, Japan. In 1890, Mitsubishi bought it to mine coal from under the sea.
They walled it in and built concrete apartment blocks, the first in 1916. From a distance, the island looked like a battleship.
In 1959, five thousand two hundred and fifty nine people lived on sixteen acres.
Before and during World War Two, Korean and Chinese laborers were brought here and forced to work in the mines.
In 1974, the mine closed. Within months, everyone was gone.
Today tour boats circle it, and visitors may walk only a small part of the island.
Would you spend one night alone on Battleship Island? Comment one night.
